name: DeepL
description:
DeepL brings high-accuracy translation into Claude. 

Translate text and entire documents across 100+ languages, control formality and tone, and rephrase or correct your writing, all from chat. Your organization's glossaries, style rules, and custom instructions are applied automatically, so terminology and brand voice stay consistent in every language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DeepL to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DeepL to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.deepl.com/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DeepL MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DeepL lists 14 MCP tools, including correct-text, download-document, get-custom-instruction, get-document-status, get-glossary-dictionary-entries, get-glossary-info, get-source-languages, get-style-rule, get-target-languages, list-glossaries, list-style-rules, and rephrase-text.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DeepL?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DeepL in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
DeepL requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DeepL is developed by DeepL. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
